prompt: A harvest hamlet with a big barn and a windmill.

card.name: Harvest Hamlet

site.text: A small hamlet on gentle, open farmland, with the barn and windmill standing out on the edges of the fields.

style.text: Warm rustic farm look: timber frames, thatch and plank roofs, hay bales, wheat fields, lanterns.

purpose.text: A harvest hamlet: a farming community that grows, stores and mills grain.

card.interpretation: You asked for a harvest hamlet with a big barn and a windmill. I read the site as a small village on open farmland, the style as rustic, and the purpose as a farm town. The big barn is the centrepiece landmark, and the windmill stands beside it as a second key building. Around them are farmhouses, a granary and a few small farm buildings. Size is S, kept small and low density.
assumptions: Size S: a hamlet is small.
Flat, open land is available nearby, so no terrain sculpting.
Rustic style, since none was named.
Low density, so the fields have room.
No backstory was given, so none was invented.

program.notes: Big hayloft barn with wide doors, stacked hay and grain bins; the hamlet's centrepiece, facing the fields.
Tall tower with large sails on a rise, to catch the wind; grinds the harvest, with a flour store at the base.
Small homes with thatch roofs, kitchen gardens and a well.
Raised storehouse for sacks of grain, close to the windmill and barn.
Harvest feast hall and gathering place at the heart of the hamlet.
